text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Good morning.
You've arrived right on schedule, as expected.
choice_data_list: You seem to be in a good mood.
You seem to be in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm using my day off to do some shopping.
A friend asked me to help manage things for them.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Based on her tastes and budget,
I mapped out the best town, the best shops, and the best route
to find clothes she'd be satisfied with—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
When a process falls into place so perfectly like that,
it really brings a smile to my face as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Ikuno Dictus had the best day off possible.
